facts.text: Tonight we eat what the reef gave us. Take only what you need and share the rest.
facts.why: Tonowari never says this. His real lines on Wikiquote include 'Treat them as our brothers and sisters. Teach them our ways.' Nothing about eating, taking only what you need or sharing the rest.
facts.fix: Treat them as our brothers and sisters. Teach them our ways.
